258203|a955ba26.name: Hervdana Saegrund
258203|a955ba26.text: Welcome to our humble home. Rest by the fire if ye need to dry off.

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

278-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
278-progress.text: Do you have the needed items?  Time is of the essence!!
278-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

280-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
280-accept.text:
Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg.  No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them!  I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute!  Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture.  There we go.

Now I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late!  Hurry!
280-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

280-complete.name: Unknown
280-complete.text: The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.
280-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

280-progress.name: Unknown
280-progress.text: The top of the keg slowly twists off.
280-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

283-complete.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
283-complete.text:
Thank you so much, $N!! You have saved the Stonewrought Dam!  Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise.  You have made the Kingdom and the Alliance proud, brave $C.

The Dam is once again safe. . . for the time being at least. . . .
283-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

94500-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-complete.text: Well done, $N! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, $N. Ye've done $c proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
94500-complete.title: Call of Water

94500-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-progress.text: Do you have the water yet, $N? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.
94500-progress.title: Call of Water

94501-accept.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94501-accept.text: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501-accept.title: Call of Water

94501-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94501-complete.text:
Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed. 

These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
94501-complete.title: Call of Water

94501-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94501-progress.text:
Hello again, $N. Yer looking well. 

What brings you back to me so soon?
94501-progress.title: Call of Water

94502-accept.name: Norric Lochthane
94502-accept.text:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502-accept.title: Call of Water

94502-complete.name: Unknown
94502-complete.text: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
94502-complete.title: Call of Water

94502-progress.name: Unknown
94502-progress.text: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?
94502-progress.title: Call of Water

94503-accept.name: Unknown
94503-accept.text: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503-accept.title: Call of Water

94503-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
94503-complete.text:
Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.

Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
94503-complete.title: Call of Water

94505-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
94505-accept.text:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
94505-accept.title: Call of Water

94505-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
94505-complete.text:
Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, $N. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.

Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
94505-complete.title: Call of Water

94505-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94505-progress.text: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.
94505-progress.title: Call of Water
